title: Spiritolo backup sidecar
description: Metadata file written next to a Supabase pg_dump backup. The upload-to-staging script requires this file to exist and to validate against this schema before doing any other work.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for IDE autocomplete.

taken_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured AFTER pg_dump returns successfully. Reference time T for the staleness/dirty-set computation.

staging_fingerprint.description: sha256 of `host:dbname` from SUPABASE_STAGING_DB_URL. Password and port excluded — the host is enough to distinguish Supabase projects.

applied_migrations.description: Full list of `version` values from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations on staging at backup time. Order matches Postgres' default ordering.

dump_basename.description: Basename of the .dump file at write time. Lets the uploader detect renamed/diverged pairs.

dump_sha256.description: sha256 of the dump file bytes.

dump_schema_sha256.description: sha256 of `pg_restore --schema-only <dump>` output. Stable across pg_restore runs on the same dump (the archive's TOC is canonical).

backup_script_version.description: Bumped if the sidecar format changes incompatibly.
